swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM2733XMF/NOPB uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV) while TPS61200DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (SW vs BYPASS), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (FB vs SW), Pin 4 (EN vs GND), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs OTHER), Pin 8 (NONE vs PS), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Soldering TPS61200DRCR onto a LM2733XMF/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-23-5: NONE vs VSON-10: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

CRITICAL RECTIFICATION LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: LM2733XMF/NOPB is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode footprint near SW, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: TPS61200DRCR is rated up to only 5.5 V output (p.6) vs LM2733XMF/NOPB up to 38 V (p.3); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: LM2733XMF/NOPB cannot regulate below 5 V (p.12) vs TPS61200DRCR down to 1.8 V (p.6); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (LM2733XMF/NOPB: 1.23 V p.4 vs TPS61200DRCR: 0.5 V p.6); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (LM2733XMF/NOPB: 10 µH p.1 vs TPS61200DRCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (LM2733XMF/NOPB: 14 V p.4 vs TPS61200DRCR: 5.5 V p.5); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: LM2733XMF/NOPB specifies 1000 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.4) vs TPS61200DRCR 1350 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.6). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS61200DRCR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (7 V, p.5) than LM2733XMF/NOPB (14.5 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 410% higher on LM2733XMF/NOPB (LM2733XMF/NOPB: 210 °C/W p.4 vs TPS61200DRCR: 41.2 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM2733XMF/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 2.7 V (p.4) vs 0.3 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM2733XMF/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ) vs TPS61200DRCR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C)); TPS61200DRCR hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM2733XMF/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS61200DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (SW vs BYPASS), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (FB vs SW), Pin 4 (EN vs GND), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs OTHER), Pin 8 (NONE vs PS), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (SW vs BYPASS), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (FB vs SW), Pin 4 (EN vs GND). Power-stage deltas: boost (non-sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 1600 kHz (p.5) vs 1450 kHz (p.6) (1.1x ratio), typical inductor 10 µH (p.1) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), feedback Vref 1.23 V (p.4) vs 0.5 V (p.6), and package θJA 210 vs 41.2 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM2733XMF/NOPB "Mandatory Feedforward Capacitor Cf Across R1 Prevents Loop Oscillation" (p.13) and TPS61200DRCR "Inverted PS Polarity (Fixed in Rev D) & Mandatory UVLO-to-VAUX / VAUX-Snubber Connections" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose LM2733XMF/NOPB when bus voltage exceeds 5.5 V (rated to 14 V) or programmed output rails exceed 5.5 V (up to 38 V); choose TPS61200DRCR when you want synchronous rectification without an external Schottky diode or higher switch current capacity (1350 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
